```{python}
                 desc=f"Share (%) of origin-bootstrap draws in which the difference is below zero, {what}")
latex.report("evPairedOrigins", int(PAIRED["n_origins"].max()), desc="Late-era origins resampled by the paired bootstrap")
latex.report("evPairedDraws", int(CK["paired_draws"]), desc="Origin-bootstrap draws of the paired differences")
# One row group per forecaster compared with the flow field, its horizon bands as rows.
PAIRED_OUT = PAIRED.assign(
    Group=lambda d: d["b"].replace({"Lee–Carter, last 50 years, actual jump-off":
                                    "Lee–Carter, last 50 years, observed jump-off"}),
    **{"Years ahead": lambda d: d["band"], "Below 0 (%)": lambda d: 100 * d["share_below"]})
PAIRED_OUT = PAIRED_OUT.rename(columns={"n_points": "Points", "diff": "Difference",
                                        "lo": "Bootstrap: 2.5 %", "hi": "Bootstrap: 97.5 %"})
PAIRED_OUT = PAIRED_OUT[["Group", "Years ahead", "Points", "Difference", "Bootstrap: 2.5 %", "Bootstrap: 97.5 %",
                         "Below 0 (%)"]]
if (PAIRED_OUT["Group"] != PAIRED_OUT["Group"].shift()).sum() != PAIRED_OUT["Group"].nunique():
    raise ValueError("the paired differences are not ordered by forecaster: a row group would repeat")
save_table(PAIRED_OUT, "tbl-ev-paired",
           "Paired differences of the MAE of $e_0$ (the average of the sexes, years): the flow field's MAE minus "
           "the other forecaster's, on the late-era points where both are scored (Points), by horizon band.  "
           f"The bootstrap resamples the {int(PAIRED['n_origins'].max())} late-era origins with replacement "
           f"({int(CK['paired_draws']):,} draws); its 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles, and the share of draws in "
           "which the difference is below zero (Below 0: the flow field more accurate), which describes the "
           "resampling "
           "and is not a p-value.  Lee--Carter from its observed jump-off is one of the sensitivity analyses, "
           "and FR2-all one of the variants outside the comparison.",
           short_caption="Paired differences of the MAE of $e_0$",
           formats=formats(PAIRED_OUT, 2, ints=["Points"]) | {"Below 0 (%)": "{:.0f}"},
           groups="Group", spanners=": ", colsep=4)


def pair_cells(rows):
    """The forecasters and bands of some rows of the paired table, as words."""
    return "; ".join(f"{ev.entry_phrase(b).replace(', actual jump-off', ' from the observed jump-off')} at "
                     f"{', '.join(g['band'])} years" for b, g in rows.groupby("b", sort=False)) or "no forecaster"


PAIRED_BELOW, PAIRED_ABOVE = pair_cells(PAIRED[PAIRED["hi"] < 0]), pair_cells(PAIRED[PAIRED["lo"] > 0])
PAIRED_OUT.round(2)
```

The bootstrap interval lies below zero (the flow field more accurate) against
`{python} PAIRED_BELOW`, and above zero against `{python} PAIRED_ABOVE`.  In the other cells
it includes zero: with `{python} num("evPairedOrigins")` origins resampled, those differences
are not distinguished from the variation between periods.

## Generality

Three properties of a general forecaster, in the companion only, for every
entry but bayesLife and the
ensemble:

1. **More history must not hurt:** the MAE with every year minus the MAE with
   the last 50 years, at horizons up to 15, in each era, must not exceed the
   margin: twice the typical standard error of a regret between forecasters in
   that era and band (the median, over the other entries, of the standard error of the
   difference of MAE between the flow field and that entry, over a bootstrap of population
   families).  For the flow field the comparison is with its windowed
   variant.  The entry already estimates its shape law and its pace beyond
   the frontier point on the last 50 years, so this test varies the window of
   its remaining speed only; the window curve below varies every component.
2. **Stable structure across origins:** the flow field's frontier point,
   its speed there, its pace beyond, the shrinkage weight and the relaxation
   rates by origin (chapter 11, @tbl-fc-flow); MDMx's damping ρ by origin
   (@tbl-ev-rho, after the generality table).
3. **Bounded regret out of era:** each entry's early-era MAE minus the best
   entry's, by band.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-generality
#| tbl-cap: "Generality: whether more history hurts (MAE with every year minus with the last 50 years, horizons 1–15, against margins of twice the typical standard error of a regret) and the early-era regret by band."
dev_both = both_err[both_err["era"].isin(list(D.eras))]
WM = E["window_margins"]
MARGIN_TAB = ev.regret_margins(dev_both, D, ev.FLOW_FIELD, [e for e in ENTRIES if e != ev.FLOW_FIELD], FAMILY,
                               WM["bands"], multiplier=float(WM["multiplier"]), draws=int(WM["draws"]),
                               seed=int(WM["seed"]))
MARGINS = {era: dict(zip(g["band"], g["margin"], strict=True)) for era, g in MARGIN_TAB.groupby("era", sort=False)}
for _, r_ in MARGIN_TAB.iterrows():
    latex.report(f"evMargin{ERA_TAG[r_['era']]}{BAND_TAG[r_['band']]}", r_["margin"], digits=2,
                 desc=f"Margin of the test that more history must not hurt (years), {r_['era']} era, horizons "
                      f"{r_['band']}: {WM['multiplier']} × the median bootstrap SE of a difference of MAE")
latex.report("evMarginDraws", int(WM["draws"]), desc="Bootstrap draws of the margins of the generality test")
gen_pairs = {"MDMx + anchor": ("MDMx + anchor, all years", "MDMx + anchor, last 50 years"),
             "Lee–Carter": ("Lee–Carter, all years", "Lee–Carter, last 50 years"),
             "Hyndman–Ullah": ("Hyndman–Ullah, all years", "Hyndman–Ullah, last 50 years"),
             "Coherent FDM": ("Coherent FDM, all years", "Coherent FDM, last 50 years")}
ffw = ev.long_points({"Flow field, windowed": ff_form("Flow field, windowed")})
ffw_err = ev.errors(ffw, truth, keys)
ffw_err = ffw_err[ffw_err["measure"] == "e0_both"].assign(era=lambda d: d["origin"].map(ERA_OF))
grows = []
for name, (all_, win_) in [*gen_pairs.items(), ("Flow field", ("Flow field", "Flow field, windowed"))]:
    e_all = dev_both[dev_both["entry"] == all_]
    e_win = ffw_err if win_ == "Flow field, windowed" else dev_both[dev_both["entry"] == win_]
    rob = ev.window_robustness(ev.band_table(e_all.assign(entry=name), D, ["entry", "era"]),
                               ev.band_table(e_win.assign(entry=name), D, ["entry", "era"]), MARGINS, ["entry"])
    row = {"Entry": name}
    for era in D.eras:
        r_ = rob[rob["era"] == era]
        row[f"{era}: largest excess"] = float((r_["diff"] - r_["margin"]).max())
        row[f"{era}: hurts"] = "yes" if bool(r_["hurts"].any()) else "no"
    grows.append(row)
early_bands = ev.regret(bands[(bands["era"] == "early") & bands["band"].isin(BANDS[:3])
                              & bands["entry"].isin(ENTRIES)])
reg = early_bands.pivot_table(index="entry", columns="band", values="regret", observed=True)
gen_tab = pd.DataFrame(grows)
for name, (all_, _) in [*gen_pairs.items(), ("Flow field", ("Flow field", None))]:
    for b in BANDS[:3]:
        gen_tab.loc[gen_tab["Entry"] == name, f"early regret {b}"] = reg.loc[all_, b]
GEN_OUT = gen_tab.rename(columns={
    **{f"{era}: largest excess": f"{ERA_HEAD[era]}: Largest\nexcess" for era in D.eras},
    **{f"{era}: hurts": f"{ERA_HEAD[era]}: Hurts" for era in D.eras},
    **{f"early regret {b}": f"Early-era regret: {b}" for b in BANDS[:3]}})
save_table(GEN_OUT, "tbl-ev-generality",
           "Generality of the forecasters (origins 1900--2000).  More history hurts if the MAE of $e_0$ with "
           "every year exceeds the MAE with the last 50 years by more than the margin in some band up to 15 "
           "years: twice the typical standard error of a regret between forecasters in that era and band "
           "(largest excess over the margin shown; negative: within it).  For the flow "
           "field the comparison is with its windowed variant.  Early regret: the entry's early-era MAE "
           "minus the best entry's (all-years fits).",
           short_caption="Generality of the forecasters", formats=formats(GEN_OUT, 2), spanners=": ",
           rank=[ranked(GEN_OUT)], rank_note="in each column, the best being the smallest excess and regret")
HURTS = {r_["Entry"]: [era for era in D.eras if r_[f"{era}: hurts"] == "yes"] for _, r_ in gen_tab.iterrows()}
best_early = reg.loc[:, BANDS[:3]].idxmin().unique()
GEN_TAG = {"MDMx + anchor": "Mdmx", "Lee–Carter": "Lc", "Hyndman–Ullah": "Hu", "Coherent FDM": "Cfdm",
           "Flow field": "Ff"}
for _, row in gen_tab.iterrows():
    for era in D.eras:
        latex.report(f"evHistoryExcess{GEN_TAG[row['Entry']]}{ERA_TAG[era]}", row[f"{era}: largest excess"],
                     digits=2,
                     desc=f"{row['Entry']}: largest excess of MAE(all years) − MAE(last 50) over the margin, {era} era")


def hurt_text(era):
    """The comparators that more history hurts in ``era``, each with its largest excess over the margin."""
    names = {"Lee–Carter": "Lee–Carter", "Hyndman–Ullah": "Hyndman–Ullah", "Coherent FDM": "the coherent model"}
    parts = []
    for e, name in names.items():
        if era in HURTS[e]:
            key = f"evHistoryExcess{GEN_TAG[e]}{ERA_TAG[era]}"
            # An excess that prints as 0.00 is still above the margin: say so rather than print zero.
            by = "less than 0.01 years" if round(val(key), 2) == 0 else f"{num(key)} years"
            parts.append(f"{name} (by {by})")
    if not parts:
        return "none of the comparators"
    return parts[0] if len(parts) == 1 else ", ".join(parts[:-1]) + " and " + parts[-1]


gen_tab.round(2)
```

MDMx's structure by origin is its damping factor ρ (chapter 11, step 3), one
per population and fitting period, fitted only to data up to the origin.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-rho
#| tbl-cap: "MDMx's structure by origin (development origins): the damping factor ρ (quartiles over the populations) and the median drift target of the first score, every year and the last 50 years."
rho = pd.concat([r["jobs"][["pop", "origin", "rho", "target_1"]].assign(policy=pol)
                 for pol in ("full", "win") for o, r in runs["mdmx"][pol].items() if ERA_OF[int(o)] in D.eras])
POL_NAME = {"full": "every year", "win": f"last {D.window} years"}
rho_tab = (rho.groupby(["origin", "policy"])["rho"].describe()[["count", "25%", "50%", "75%"]]
           .join(rho.groupby(["origin", "policy"])["target_1"].median().rename("drift target"))
           .unstack("policy"))
STAT_RHO = {"count": "Popu-\nlations", "25%": "25 %", "50%": "50 %", "75%": "75 %", "drift target": "Drift\ntarget"}
rho_tab.columns = [f"{POL_NAME[pol].capitalize()}: {STAT_RHO[stat]}" for stat, pol in rho_tab.columns]
rho_tab = rho_tab[[c for pol in POL_NAME.values() for c in rho_tab.columns
                   if c.startswith(pol.capitalize())]].reset_index().rename(columns={"origin": "Origin"})
save_table(rho_tab, "tbl-ev-rho",
           "MDMx's structure by origin (origins 1900--2000): the number of populations, the quartiles of the "
           "damping factor $\\rho$ over them, and the median drift target of the first score (per year), with "
           f"every year and with the last {D.window} years.",
           short_caption="MDMx's structure by origin",
           formats=formats(rho_tab, 3, ints=[c for c in rho_tab.columns if c.endswith("lations")])
           | {"Origin": latex.fmt_year}, spanners=": ")
lo_bound = ctx["mdmx"].rho_bounds[0]
q25 = rho[rho["policy"] == "win"].groupby("origin")["rho"].quantile(0.25)
AT_BOUND = sorted(int(o) for o, v in q25.items() if ERA_OF[int(o)] == "late" and v <= lo_bound + 1e-6)
# The article writes these origins as a range, so they must be consecutive late origins.
_late = sorted(int(o) for o in D.eras["late"])
if AT_BOUND and AT_BOUND != _late[_late.index(AT_BOUND[0]):_late.index(AT_BOUND[0]) + len(AT_BOUND)]:
    raise ValueError(f"the late origins with the lower quartile of rho at the bound are not consecutive: {AT_BOUND}")
if not AT_BOUND:
    raise ValueError("no late origin has the lower quartile of rho at the bound; the article's sentence must change")
latex.report("evRhoBoundFirstOrigin", AT_BOUND[0], text=latex.fmt_year(AT_BOUND[0]),
             desc="First late origin at which the lower quartile of MDMx's rho (last 50 years) sits at its bound")
latex.report("evRhoBoundLastOrigin", AT_BOUND[-1], text=latex.fmt_year(AT_BOUND[-1]),
             desc="Last late origin at which the lower quartile of MDMx's rho (last 50 years) sits at its bound")
regret_mdmx = gen_tab.loc[gen_tab["Entry"] == "MDMx + anchor",
                          [c for c in gen_tab.columns if c.startswith("early regret")]].to_numpy().max()
latex.report("evRegretEarlyMaxMdmx", regret_mdmx, digits=2,
             desc="Anchored MDMx: largest early-era regret (MAE minus the best entry's), bands up to 15 years")
latex.report("evRegretEarlyOneFiveFf", float(reg.loc["Flow field", BANDS[0]]), digits=2,
             desc=f"Flow field: early-era regret (MAE minus the best entry's) at {BANDS[0]} years")
rho_era = rho.assign(era=rho["origin"].astype(int).map(ERA_OF))
for era in D.eras:
    for pol, ptag in (("full", "All"), ("win", "Win")):
        latex.report(f"evRhoMedian{ERA_TAG[era]}{ptag}",
                     float(rho_era[(rho_era["era"] == era) & (rho_era["policy"] == pol)]["rho"].median()), digits=2,
                     desc=f"MDMx: median damping factor rho over the {era} origins' fits, "
                          f"{'every year' if pol == 'full' else 'last 50 years'}")
rho_tab.round(3)
```

More history `{python} "does not hurt" if not HURTS["Flow field"] else "hurts"` the flow field
(largest excess of its error with every year over the margins
`{python} num("evHistoryExcessFfEarly")` years in the early era and
`{python} num("evHistoryExcessFfLate")` in the late era; negative is inside) and
`{python} "does not hurt" if not HURTS["MDMx + anchor"] else "hurts"` anchored MDMx
(`{python} num("evHistoryExcessMdmxEarly")` and `{python} num("evHistoryExcessMdmxLate")`).
Beyond the margin, more history hurts in the early era `{python} hurt_text("early")`,
and in the late era `{python} hurt_text("late")`.  Out of era, `{python} " and ".join(ev.entry_phrase(e) for e in best_early)`
`{python} "has" if len(best_early) == 1 else "have"` the smallest early-era error in the
bands up to 15 years; anchored MDMx's regret is at most
`{python} num("evRegretEarlyMaxMdmx")` years.  MDMx's damping factor is stable across origins (median
`{python} num("evRhoMedianLateAll")` with every year and
`{python} num("evRhoMedianLateWin")` with the last 50 years in the late era,
`{python} num("evRhoMedianEarlyAll")` and `{python} num("evRhoMedianEarlyWin")` in
the early era).  With the last 50 years, the lower quartile sits at the bound
of `{python} f"{lo_bound:.2f}"` at `{python} len(AT_BOUND)` of the
`{python} len(D.eras["late"])` late origins
(`{python} ", ".join(str(o) for o in AT_BOUND)`).

### The window curve

Each entry (but bayesLife and the ensemble) fitted to its last 25, 50, 75 and
100 years and to every year (development origins).  The flow
field is windowed by component: its speed only, its shape law only, both, and
both with the space estimated on the window too.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ev-window
#| fig-cap: "The window curve: mean absolute error of e₀ (average of the sexes) by fitting window, horizons 1–15 (top) and 16–50 (bottom), early era (left) and late era (right), development origins, on the common points."
WIN = [int(w) for w in E["window_curve"]]
# The window curve's two spans of horizons: up to the split, and beyond it to the end of the forecast.
SPLIT = int(E["window_curve_split"])
SPAN_SHORT, SPAN_LONG = f"1–{SPLIT}", f"{SPLIT + 1}–{D.horizon}"
report_band(SPLIT + 1, D.horizon, "the window curve's longer horizons")
latex.report("evWindowCurveShortest", min(WIN), desc="Shortest fitting window of the window curve (years)")
cmp_code = {"Lee–Carter": "LC", "Hyndman–Ullah": "HU", "Coherent FDM": "CFDM"}
curve_pts = []
for w in [*WIN, "all"]:
    if w == "all":
        md = runs["mdmx"]["full"]
        cm = runs["comparators"]["full"]
    elif w == D.window:
        md, cm = runs["mdmx"]["win"], runs["comparators"]["win"]
    else:
        md, cm = curve[w]["mdmx"], curve[w]["comparators"]
    curve_pts.append(ev.long_points({"MDMx + anchor": md}).assign(window=str(w)))
    for name, code in cmp_code.items():
        curve_pts.append(ev.long_points({name: {o: fc.comparator_points(r, code, A, ctx["cmp"]["mx_to_qx_ax"])
                                                for o, r in cm.items()}}).assign(window=str(w)))
    for form in ("speed", "shape", "dyn", "dynspace"):
        # At "every year" each curve meets the form with that component on every year: for the speed
        # curve (its shape law stays on the last 50 years) that is the entry itself.
        label = (("Flow field" if form == "speed" else "FF all") if w == "all" else f"FF {form} {w}")
        curve_pts.append(ev.long_points({f"Flow field, {form}": ff_form(label)}).assign(window=str(w)))
curve_pts = pd.concat(curve_pts, ignore_index=True)
dev_keys = keys[keys["era"].isin(list(D.eras))]
wc = curve_pts.merge(dev_keys, on=["pop", "origin", "year"]).merge(truth, on=["pop", "sex", "year"])
wc = wc[wc["sex"] == "both"].assign(err=lambda d: (d["e0_fc"] - d["e0_obs"]).abs())
# Common points: those every entry has at every window (a fit can fail at one window only).
n_var = wc.groupby(["pop", "origin", "year"])[["entry", "window"]].apply(lambda d: len(d.drop_duplicates()))
full_pts = n_var[n_var == n_var.max()].index
cmp_curve_fail = pd.concat([r["failures"].assign(window=w) for w in curve for r in curve[w]["comparators"].values()],
                           ignore_index=True)
print(f"Window curve: comparator fits that failed: {len(cmp_curve_fail)}; development points left out: "
      f"{len(n_var) - len(full_pts)} of {len(n_var)}")
if len(cmp_curve_fail):
    print(cmp_curve_fail.to_string(index=False))
wc = wc.set_index(["pop", "origin", "year"]).loc[full_pts].reset_index()
wc["span"] = np.where(wc["h"] <= SPLIT, SPAN_SHORT, SPAN_LONG)
WINDOW_CURVE = wc.groupby(["entry", "era", "span", "window"])["err"].mean().reset_index()
WCI = WINDOW_CURVE.set_index(["era", "span", "entry", "window"])["err"]
WC_TAG = {"MDMx + anchor": "Mdmx", "Lee–Carter": "Lc", "Hyndman–Ullah": "Hu", "Coherent FDM": "Cfdm",
          "Flow field, speed": "FfSpeed", "Flow field, shape": "FfShape", "Flow field, dyn": "FfDyn",
          "Flow field, dynspace": "FfDynspace"}
W_TAG = {"25": "Twentyfive", "50": "Fifty", "75": "Seventyfive", "100": "Hundred", "all": "All"}
for (era, span, entry, w), v in WCI.items():
    latex.report(f"evWindow{WC_TAG[entry]}{ERA_TAG[era]}{'Short' if span == SPAN_SHORT else 'Long'}{W_TAG[w]}", v,
                 digits=2, desc=f"Window curve: {entry}, {era} era, horizons {span}, window {w}")
order = [str(w) for w in WIN] + ["all"]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(10, 7), sharex=True)
colors = {"MDMx + anchor": "#1f78b4", "Lee–Carter": plotting.COLORS["LC"], "Hyndman–Ullah": plotting.COLORS["HU"],
          "Coherent FDM": plotting.COLORS["CFDM"], "Flow field, speed": "#b2df8a", "Flow field, shape": "#33a02c",
          "Flow field, dyn": plotting.COLORS["MDMx"], "Flow field, dynspace": "#a6cee3"}
# The legend's names: the flow field's curves by the components fitted to the window.
WC_NAME = {"Flow field, speed": "Flow field: speed", "Flow field, shape": "Flow field: shape law",
           "Flow field, dyn": "Flow field: speed and shape law",
           "Flow field, dynspace": "Flow field: speed, shape law and space"}
for i, span in enumerate((SPAN_SHORT, SPAN_LONG)):
    for j, era in enumerate(D.eras):
        ax = axes[i, j]
        for name, col in colors.items():
            c = WINDOW_CURVE[(WINDOW_CURVE["entry"] == name) & (WINDOW_CURVE["era"] == era)
                             & (WINDOW_CURVE["span"] == span)].set_index("window").reindex(order)
            ax.plot(order, c["err"], marker="o", ms=3, color=col, label=WC_NAME.get(name, shown_name(name)))
        ax.set_title(f"{era.capitalize()} era, horizons {span}")
        if j == 0:
            ax.set_ylabel("MAE of e₀ (years)")
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel("Fitting window (years)")
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel("Fitting window (years)")
axes[0, 1].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=6)
plotting.save_figure(fig, "fig-ev-window");
```

Anchored MDMx barely depends on its window: its late-era error at `{python} SPAN_SHORT` years
ranges from `{python} f"{WCI.loc[('late', SPAN_SHORT, 'MDMx + anchor')].min():.2f}"` to
`{python} f"{WCI.loc[('late', SPAN_SHORT, 'MDMx + anchor')].max():.2f}"` years across the windows.
In the late era Lee–Carter is best with 50 years
(`{python} num("evWindowLcLateShortFifty")`, against `{python} num("evWindowLcLateShortAll")`
with every year and `{python} num("evWindowLcLateShortTwentyfive")` with `{python} min(WIN)`); in the early era
all three comparators are best with the shortest window (Lee–Carter
`{python} num("evWindowLcEarlyShortTwentyfive")` with `{python} min(WIN)` years against
`{python} num("evWindowLcEarlyShortAll")` with every year).  The flow field's
long-horizon error depends on the window of its shape law, in opposite
directions in the two eras: at `{python} SPAN_LONG` years a shape law on the last `{python} min(WIN)` years
gives `{python} num("evWindowFfShapeLateLongTwentyfive")` in the late era against
`{python} num("evWindowFfShapeLateLongAll")` on every year, but
`{python} num("evWindowFfShapeEarlyLongTwentyfive")` in the early era against
`{python} num("evWindowFfShapeEarlyLongAll")`.  The entry's form (the shape law on
the last 50 years) gives `{python} num("evWindowFfShapeLateLongFifty")` and
`{python} num("evWindowFfShapeEarlyLongFifty")`.

What this says about the guiding principle of the forecasters, one general model that uses all
the data (in the companion only).  Its strong
form, that a general model should not need to discard history, does not hold
for the flow field: two of its three components, the shape law and the pace
beyond the frontier point, use only the last 50 years, a window chosen on the
late origins (Deviation 1), and the shape law's window moves the error in
opposite directions in the two eras.  The narrowed form, pre-registered as the
fallback, is that the weight of each datum reflects its
relevance and may approach zero.  The flow field meets it only coarsely: its
window gives the older years a weight of zero, set by a choice rather than
estimated in the model.  Its remaining component, the speed, uses every year,
and there more history `{python} "does not hurt" if not HURTS["Flow field"] else "hurts"` (the generality table).

## Where the errors come from

### By age

Arriaga's decomposition (paper §10.8) splits each e₀ error into the contributions of age
groups, by sex; the contributions add up to the error exactly (checked).  Late
era, the longer horizons, for every entry with schedules.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ev-arriaga
#| fig-cap: "Where the late-era e₀ errors come from, by age: the mean Arriaga contribution of each age group to the error of female (left) and male (right) e₀, horizons 36–50, selected entries."
AGE_GROUPS = ev.age_groups([int(a) for a in E["age_group_starts"]], E["age_group_labels"], A)
late_keys = keys[keys["era"] == "late"].reset_index(drop=True)
split_rows = []
for label in ENTRIES:
    z = cp.aligned_schedules(results[label], late_keys)
    s = ev.age_split(late_keys[["pop", "origin", "year"]], z, M, observed, pops, years, AGE_GROUPS)
    split_rows.append(s.assign(entry=label, band=D.band(s["year"] - s["origin"])))
SPLIT = pd.concat(split_rows, ignore_index=True)
arr_cols = [f"arr_{g}" for g in AGE_GROUPS]
arr_mean = SPLIT[SPLIT["band"].isin(BANDS[3:])].groupby(["entry", "sex", "band"])[arr_cols].mean()
show = [e for e in ("Flow field", "MDMx + anchor, all years", "Lee–Carter, last 50 years", "bayesLife, last 50 years",
                    "Ensemble") if e in ENTRIES]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 3.8), sharey=True)
xpos = np.arange(len(AGE_GROUPS))
for ax, sex in zip(axes, ("female", "male"), strict=True):
    for k, label in enumerate(show):
        vals_ = arr_mean.loc[(label, sex, "36–50")].to_numpy()
        ax.bar(xpos + (k - (len(show) - 1) / 2) * 0.16, vals_, width=0.16, label=shown_name(label),
               color=FEATURE.get(label, "0.6"))
    ax.axhline(0, color="0.3", lw=0.6)
    ax.set_xticks(xpos, list(AGE_GROUPS))
    ax.set_title(f"{sex.capitalize()} e₀, horizons 36–50")
    ax.set_xlabel("Age group")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Mean contribution to the e₀ error (years)")
axes[1].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=6)
plotting.save_figure(fig, "fig-ev-arriaga")
for label in ("Flow field", "MDMx + anchor, all years"):
    for sex in ("female", "male"):
        old = arr_mean.loc[(label, sex, "36–50"), ["arr_65–79", "arr_80+"]].sum()
        latex.report(f"evArriagaOld{TAG[label]}{sex.capitalize()}", old, digits=2,
                     desc=f"{label}: mean contribution of ages 65+ to the {sex} e0 error, late era, h 36-50")
```

Late in the horizon every forecaster's e₀ is too low, and the shortfall comes
from old age: at 36–50 years, ages 65 and over contribute
`{python} num("evArriagaOldFfFemale")` years to the flow field's female error and
`{python} num("evArriagaOldMdmxAllFemale")` to anchored MDMx's, and
`{python} num("evArriagaOldFfMale")` and `{python} num("evArriagaOldMdmxAllMale")`
to the male errors.  bayesLife's male error is spread over every age, because
its male e₀ drifts down and its schedules follow it.

### The pace of improvement

For the forecasts that start beyond the frontier point at the late origins (paper
§10.8):
the e₀ gain per year that each forecaster implies along the horizon, beside the
gain the same populations realised and the realised pace of the frontier (the
chain-linked top three).  The realised paces use the years after the origins:
they describe what happened and are never an input to a forecast.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ev-pace
#| fig-cap: "The e₀ gain per year along the horizon for the forecasts that start beyond the frontier point (late origins): implied by four forecasters, realised by the same populations, and realised at the frontier. Five-year centred means."
POS = pd.concat([r["positions"].assign(origin=o) for o, r in runs["flowfield"].items()], ignore_index=True)
beyond = POS[(POS["position"] == "beyond") & POS["origin"].isin(D.eras["late"])][["pop", "origin"]]
pace_entries = ["Flow field", "MDMx + anchor, all years", "Lee–Carter, last 50 years", ev.NAIVE]
pb = points[points["entry"].isin(pace_entries) & (points["sex"] == "both")].merge(beyond, on=["pop", "origin"])
fpace_all = ev.forecast_pace(pb[["entry", "pop", "sex", "origin", "year", "e0_fc"]])
fpace = fpace_all.groupby(["entry", "h"])["gain"].mean().reset_index()
# The realised gain at the last band exists only for the origins that reach it; the implied gain there is
# compared on the same origins.
END_ORIGINS = [o for o in D.eras["late"] if o + D.bands[-1][0] <= int(years[-1])]
fpace_end = fpace_all[fpace_all["origin"].isin(END_ORIGINS)].groupby(["entry", "h"])["gain"].mean()
real = ev.realised_pace(truth[truth["sex"] == "both"])
real = real.merge(beyond, on="pop").assign(h=lambda d: d["year"] - d["origin"])
real = real[(real["h"] >= 1) & (real["h"] <= D.horizon)].groupby("h")["gain"].mean()
front = ev.frontier_pace(ctx["e0"], observed, years, int(E["frontier_k"])).set_index("year")["gain"]
front_h = pd.DataFrame([{"h": h, "gain": front.get(o + h, np.nan)} for o in D.eras["late"]
                        for h in range(1, D.horizon + 1)]).groupby("h")["gain"].mean()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
for label in pace_entries:
    c = fpace[fpace["entry"] == label].set_index("h")["gain"].rolling(5, center=True, min_periods=1).mean()
    ax.plot(c.index, c, color=FEATURE.get(label, "0.5"), lw=1.8, ls="--" if label == ev.NAIVE else "-",
            label=shown_name(label))
ax.plot(real.index, real.rolling(5, center=True, min_periods=1).mean(), color="k", lw=1.8,
        label="Realised, the same populations")
ax.plot(front_h.index, front_h.rolling(5, center=True, min_periods=1).mean(), color="k", lw=1.2, ls=":",
        label="Realised frontier (top 3)")
ax.set_xlabel("Years after the origin")
ax.set_ylabel("Gain in e₀ per year (years)")
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=7)
plotting.save_figure(fig, "fig-ev-pace")
# The implied gain at the start of the horizon: the first horizons that have one (config: pace_start).
PACE_LO, PACE_HI = (int(h) for h in E["pace_start"])
report_band(PACE_LO, PACE_HI, "the start of the horizon for the implied gain in e0")
for label in ("Flow field", "MDMx + anchor, all years"):
    c = fpace[fpace["entry"] == label].set_index("h")["gain"]
    latex.report(f"evPaceStart{TAG[label]}", c.loc[PACE_LO:PACE_HI].mean(), digits=3,
                 desc=f"{label}: mean implied e0 gain per year at horizons {PACE_LO}-{PACE_HI} (jobs beyond s1*, "
                      "late era)")
    lo_, hi_ = D.bands[-1]
    latex.report(f"evPaceEnd{TAG[label]}", fpace_end.loc[label].loc[lo_:hi_].mean(), digits=3,
                 desc=f"{label}: mean implied e0 gain per year in the last band (jobs beyond s1*, late origins "
                      "that reach it)")
latex.report("evPaceRealisedEnd", real.loc[D.bands[-1][0]:D.bands[-1][1]].mean(), digits=3,
             desc="Realised e0 gain per year in the last band, the same populations")
```

The forecasters imply a slowing gain: for the forecasts that start beyond the
frontier point, the flow field's implied gain falls from
`{python} num("evPaceStartFf")` years of e₀ per year at `{python} PACE_LO`–`{python} PACE_HI` years ahead to
`{python} num("evPaceEndFf")` at `{python} BANDS[-1]`, and anchored MDMx's from
`{python} num("evPaceStartMdmxAll")` to `{python} num("evPaceEndMdmxAll")`.  The
same populations realised `{python} num("evPaceRealisedEnd")` years per year at
`{python} BANDS[-1]` years after the origin.  Only the origins up to
`{python} max(END_ORIGINS)` reach so far, so the implied gains at that band are taken
over the same origins, and the realised curve is noisy.  Both forecasters slow
down more than the populations did; the flow field less so.

### By starting position

The flow field's late-era error by where the forecast starts: beyond the
frontier point, near it (below it by at most
`{python} f"{float(E['positions_near']):.0%}"` of the range of s₁), or far below it.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-positions
#| tbl-cap: "The flow field's late-era error of e₀ (average of the sexes) by starting position relative to the frontier point: mean error (bias) and MAE by horizon band."
ffe = both_err[(both_err["entry"] == "Flow field") & (both_err["era"] == "late")].merge(
    POS[["pop", "origin", "position"]], on=["pop", "origin"])
ffe["band"] = pd.Categorical(D.band(ffe["h"]), categories=BANDS, ordered=True)
pos_tab = ffe.groupby(["position", "band"], observed=True)["error"].agg(
    me="mean", mae=lambda x: float(np.mean(np.abs(x))), n="size").reset_index()
pos_wide = pos_tab.pivot_table(index="position", columns="band", values=["me", "mae"], observed=True)
pos_out = pos_wide.copy()
pos_out.columns = [f"{s} {b}" for s, b in pos_out.columns]
POS_TAB = pos_out.reset_index()
for pos_, row in pos_out.iterrows():
    for b in BANDS:
        if np.isfinite(row.get(f"mae {b}", np.nan)):
            latex.report(f"evPos{pos_.capitalize()}Mae{BAND_TAG[b]}", row[f"mae {b}"], digits=2,
                         desc=f"Flow field, late era, start {pos_} the frontier point: MAE, horizons {b}")
            latex.report(f"evPos{pos_.capitalize()}Bias{BAND_TAG[b]}", row[f"me {b}"], digits=2,
                         desc=f"Flow field, late era, start {pos_} the frontier point: mean error, horizons {b}")
POS_NAME = {"beyond": "Beyond the frontier point", "near": "Near it", "far": "Far below it"}
POS_OUT = years_ahead(pd.concat(
    [pos_wide[st].reindex(columns=BANDS).rename_axis("Position").reset_index().assign(Group=name)
     for st, name in (("mae", "MAE of $e_0$"), ("me", "Mean error of $e_0$"))], ignore_index=True)
    [["Group", "Position", *BANDS]])
POS_OUT["Position"] = POS_OUT["Position"].map(lambda v: POS_NAME.get(v, v))
save_table(POS_OUT, "tbl-ev-positions",
           "The flow field's late-era error of $e_0$ (the average of the sexes, years) by starting position: "
           "beyond the frontier point, near it (below by at most a fifth of the range of $s_1$) or far "
           "below.",
           short_caption="Error by starting position", formats=formats(POS_OUT, 2), groups="Group", spanners=": ")
pos_out.round(2)
```

Beyond the frontier point the flow field is nearly unbiased up to 25 years
ahead and its error is smallest (`{python} num("evPosBeyondMaeOneFive")` years at 1–5
years ahead); near the frontier point it is larger
(`{python} num("evPosNearMaeOneFive")`); far below it, it forecasts too little
improvement (`{python} num("evPosFarMaeOneFive")` at 1–5 years and a mean error of
`{python} num("evPosFarBiasSixteenTwentyfive")` at 16–25).

### The frontier's pace and the flow field's speed beyond it

```{python}
#| label: fig-ev-frontier
#| fig-cap: "By origin: the leading populations' e₀ pace over the 50 years before the origin (the same leaders and years whose pace in s₁ the flow field uses beyond the frontier point), the flow field's implied e₀ gain 2–5 years ahead for the forecasts that start beyond the frontier point, the frontier's realised e₀ pace over up to 25 years after the origin (evaluation only; fewer years from 1995 on, where the data end or the COVID-19 years are masked), and the flow field's speed beyond the frontier point in s₁ units (right axis). The shaded origins after 2000 are the held-out block, shown as data only: the text's numbers are taken over the development origins."
FLOWS = pd.DataFrame([{"origin": o, **r["runs"]["Flow field"]["flow"]} for o, r in runs["flowfield"].items()])
# The frontier's realised pace over the years after each origin (config: frontier_after).
AFTER = int(E["frontier_after"])
latex.report("evFrontierAfterYears", AFTER, desc="Years after the origin over which the frontier's realised pace is taken")
fwd = pd.Series({o: front.loc[o + 1:o + AFTER].mean() for o in FLOWS["origin"]})
# The flow field's own implied e₀ gain beyond the frontier point at the start of the horizon, at every origin.
beyond_all = POS[POS["position"] == "beyond"][["pop", "origin"]]
pb_ff = points[(points["entry"] == "Flow field") & (points["sex"] == "both")].merge(beyond_all, on=["pop", "origin"])
ff_gain = ev.forecast_pace(pb_ff[["entry", "pop", "sex", "origin", "year", "e0_fc"]])
ff_gain = ff_gain[ff_gain["h"].between(PACE_LO, PACE_HI)].groupby("origin")["gain"].mean()
fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.8))
# The held-out origins are drawn as data only: shaded, and left out of every number below.
HELD_SHOWN = sorted(o for o in FLOWS["origin"] if ERA_OF[o] == "held")
if HELD_SHOWN:
    STEP = int(np.diff(D.origins).min())
    ax1.axvspan(HELD_SHOWN[0] - STEP / 2, HELD_SHOWN[-1] + STEP / 2, color="0.9", lw=0, zorder=0)
    ax1.text((HELD_SHOWN[0] + HELD_SHOWN[-1]) / 2, 0.02, "recent\norigins\n(data only)",
             transform=ax1.get_xaxis_transform(), ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7, color="0.35")
ax1.plot(FLOWS["origin"], FLOWS["V_e"], marker="o", ms=3, color="k", label="Frontier e₀ pace, 50 years before")
ax1.plot(fwd.index, fwd.values, marker="o", ms=3, color="k", ls=":",
         label=f"Frontier e₀ pace, up to {AFTER} years after")
ax1.plot(ff_gain.index, ff_gain.values, marker="^", ms=3, color=plotting.COLORS["MDMx"], ls="--",
         label=f"Flow field's implied e₀ gain, {PACE_LO}–{PACE_HI} years ahead (beyond s₁*)")
ax1.set_ylabel("e₀ per year (years)")
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(FLOWS["origin"], FLOWS["v1"], marker="s", ms=3, color=plotting.COLORS["MDMx"],
         label="Flow field's speed beyond s₁* (s₁ per year)")
ax2.set_ylabel("s₁ per year")
ax1.set_xlabel("Origin")
lines = ax1.get_lines() + ax2.get_lines()
ax1.legend(lines, [ln.get_label() for ln in lines], frameon=False, fontsize=7, ncol=2, loc="upper center",
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.17))
plotting.save_figure(fig, "fig-ev-frontier");
FR = pd.DataFrame({"ve": FLOWS.set_index("origin")["V_e"], "fwd": fwd, "ff": ff_gain})
FR = FR[FR.index.map(ERA_OF).isin(list(D.eras))]                   # development origins only
latex.report("evFrontierPaceMax", float(FR["ve"].max()), digits=2,
             desc="The leaders' e0 pace over the 50 years before the origin: its highest (development origins)")
latex.report("evFrontierPaceMaxOrigin", int(FR["ve"].idxmax()), text=latex.fmt_year(int(FR["ve"].idxmax())),
             desc="The development origin at which the leaders' e0 pace over the 50 years before it was highest")
latex.report("evFrontierPaceLast", float(FR["ve"].iloc[-1]), digits=2,
             desc="The leaders' e0 pace over the 50 years before the last development origin")
latex.report("evFrontierFfGainExcessMax", float((FR["ff"] - FR["fwd"]).max()), digits=2,
             desc=f"Largest excess of the flow field's implied gain ({PACE_LO}-{PACE_HI} years, beyond s1*) over the "
                  f"frontier's realised pace over the next {AFTER} years (development origins)")
FR_DIFF = (FR["ff"] - FR["fwd"]).dropna()
latex.report("evFrontierFfGainShortMax", float(-FR_DIFF.min()), digits=2,
             desc=f"Largest shortfall of the flow field's implied gain ({PACE_LO}-{PACE_HI} years, beyond s1*) below "
                  f"the frontier's realised pace over the next {AFTER} years (development origins)")
latex.report("evFrontierFfGainShortOrigin", int(FR_DIFF.idxmin()), text=latex.fmt_year(int(FR_DIFF.idxmin())),
             desc="The development origin of that largest shortfall")
latex.report("evFrontierFfGainBelowN", int((FR_DIFF < 0).sum()),
             desc="Development origins at which the flow field's implied gain beyond s1* was below the frontier's "
                  "realised pace")
latex.report("evFrontierFfGainN", len(FR_DIFF), desc="Development origins compared in the frontier figure")
latex.report("evFrontierFfGainExcessOrigin", int(FR_DIFF.idxmax()), text=latex.fmt_year(int(FR_DIFF.idxmax())),
             desc="The development origin of the largest excess")
```

The leaders' e₀ pace over the 50 years before the origin was highest at
`{python} num("evFrontierPaceMaxOrigin")` (`{python} num("evFrontierPaceMax")` years of
e₀ per year) and `{python} num("evFrontierPaceLast")` at the last development origin.  The
flow field uses the same leaders' pace in s₁, not in e₀; what it implies in e₀
is its gain `{python} PACE_LO`–`{python} PACE_HI` years ahead for the forecasts that start beyond the frontier
point.  That gain differed from the frontier's realised pace over the next `{python} AFTER` years
in both directions: it was below it at `{python} num("evFrontierFfGainBelowN")` of the
`{python} num("evFrontierFfGainN")` development origins, by up to
`{python} num("evFrontierFfGainShortMax")` years per year (at `{python} num("evFrontierFfGainShortOrigin")`),
and above it at the others, by up to `{python} num("evFrontierFfGainExcessMax")` (at
`{python} num("evFrontierFfGainExcessOrigin")`); at the development origins from 1980 the two
differ by at most `{python} f"{(FR['ff'] - FR['fwd']).loc[1980:].abs().max():.2f}"`.

## Run time

Wall-clock and CPU time per origin and fitting period.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-runtime
#| tbl-cap: "Run time per origin and fitting period: wall-clock seconds (median and largest over the origins) and the total."
# Where each bayesLife run ran: the user name in its simulation folder's path names the machine.
BLM = E["bl_machines"]
bl_user = {}
for (p_, o) in BL_RUNS:
    cfg = json.loads((BL_FOLDER / "results" / f"{p_}-{o}" / "settings.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    parts = Path(cfg["sim_dir"]).parts
    user = parts[parts.index("Users") + 1] if "Users" in parts else ""
    if user not in BLM:
        raise ValueError(f"bayesLife run {p_}-{o} ran under an unknown user {user!r}: add it to [evaluation.bl_machines]")
    bl_user[(p_, o)] = user
rt = []
for pol in ("full", "win"):
    s_ = pd.Series({o: r["seconds"] for o, r in runs["mdmx"][pol].items()})
    c_ = pd.Series({o: r["cpu_seconds"] for o, r in runs["mdmx"][pol].items()})
    rt.append({"Method": f"MDMx + anchor ({'all years' if pol == 'full' else 'last 50 years'})", "runs": len(s_),
               "median s": s_.median(), "largest s": s_.max(), "total h": s_.sum() / 3600,
               "CPU total h": c_.sum() / 3600})
    s_ = pd.Series({o: r["seconds"] for o, r in runs["comparators"][pol].items()})
    rt.append({"Method": f"Lee–Carter + Hyndman–Ullah + coherent FDM ({'all years' if pol == 'full' else 'last 50 years'})",
               "runs": len(s_), "median s": s_.median(), "largest s": s_.max(), "total h": s_.sum() / 3600})
    for user in sorted(set(bl_user.values())):
        s_ = pd.Series({o: r["provenance"]["hours"] * 3600 for (p_, o), r in BL_RUNS.items()
                        if p_ == pol and bl_user[(p_, o)] == user})
        if len(s_):
            rt.append({"Method": f"bayesLife ({'all years' if pol == 'full' else 'last 50 years'}), "
                                 f"{BLM[user]['machine']}", "runs": len(s_), "median s": s_.median(),
                       "largest s": s_.max(), "total h": s_.sum() / 3600, "CPU total h": np.nan})
s_ = pd.Series({o: r["seconds"]["Flow field"] for o, r in runs["flowfield"].items()})
c_ = pd.Series({o: r["cpu_seconds"]["Flow field"] for o, r in runs["flowfield"].items()})
rt.append({"Method": "Flow field", "runs": len(s_), "median s": s_.median(), "largest s": s_.max(),
           "total h": s_.sum() / 3600, "CPU total h": c_.sum() / 3600})


def _space_seconds():
    """Seconds to estimate, at each origin, the space the two forecasters share (the flow field's runs above
    start from it; anchored MDMx's time includes it)."""
    import time
    ms_, rows_ = ctx["mdmx"], []
    for o in sorted(int(x) for x in runs["flowfield"]):
        w0, c0 = time.perf_counter(), time.process_time()
        fc.origin_space(M, observed, years, o, tau=ms_.tau, age_rank=ms_.age_rank, smooth=ms_.smooth, n_pc=ms_.n_pc)
        rows_.append({"origin": o, "seconds": time.perf_counter() - w0, "cpu_seconds": time.process_time() - c0})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows_)


SPACE_T = artifacts.stage("evaluation_space_seconds", _space_seconds, inputs=["tensor"],
                          params={"mdmx": ctx["mdmx"].as_dict(), "origins": sorted(int(x) for x in runs["flowfield"])},
                          code=[_space_seconds], desc="Seconds to estimate the space the two forecasters share, per origin")
SPACE_T = SPACE_T.set_index("origin")
FF_SPACE = s_.rename(index=int) + SPACE_T["seconds"]
FF_SPACE_CPU = c_.rename(index=int) + SPACE_T["cpu_seconds"]
if FF_SPACE.isna().any():
    raise ValueError("the space's timing does not cover every origin of the flow field's runs")
rt.append({"Method": "Flow field, with the space it shares with anchored MDMx", "runs": len(FF_SPACE),
           "median s": FF_SPACE.median(), "largest s": FF_SPACE.max(), "total h": FF_SPACE.sum() / 3600,
           "CPU total h": FF_SPACE_CPU.sum() / 3600})
BL_WHERE = "; ".join(
    f"{sum(u == user for u in bl_user.values())} on {BLM[user]['machine']}, {BLM[user]['at_once']} at a time"
    + (" (this book's reference machine)" if user == BLM["main"] else "")
    for user in sorted(set(bl_user.values()), key=lambda u: u != BLM["main"]))
rt_tab = pd.DataFrame(rt).rename(columns={"runs": "Runs", "median s": "Wall clock: Median (s)",
                                          "largest s": "Wall clock: Largest (s)", "total h": "Wall clock: Total (h)",
                                          "CPU total h": "CPU: Total (h)"})
BL_ELSEWHERE = sum(u != BLM["main"] for u in bl_user.values())
latex.report("evRuntimeBlRunsElsewhere", BL_ELSEWHERE, desc="bayesLife runs made off the reference machine")
WHERE_RUN = ("Every method ran on one machine" + (
    f" except {num('evRuntimeBlRunsElsewhere')} of bayesLife's {num('evBlRuns')} runs, made on a second machine "
    "(each machine's bayesLife runs have rows of their own; see the text)" if BL_ELSEWHERE else "") + ".  ")
save_table(rt_tab, "tbl-ev-runtime",
           "Run time per origin and fitting period: the number of runs (origins), wall-clock seconds, median "
           "and largest over them, and the total in hours.  " + WHERE_RUN + "bayesLife: each run's three "
           "chains in parallel; MDMx: the fits in parallel worker processes.  CPU: where recorded (the R "
           "processes' CPU time is not).  The flow field's own row starts from the space it shares with "
           "anchored MDMx (the decomposition and the principal components at the origin), whose estimation "
           "anchored MDMx's time includes; the row below it adds that estimation.  Indicative: runs shared cores.",
           short_caption="Run time", formats=formats(rt_tab, 2, ints=["Runs"]), spanners=": ",
           wrap={"Method": "5.2cm"},
           rank=[ranked(rt_tab, "min", columns=["Wall clock: Median (s)", "Wall clock: Largest (s)",
                                                "Wall clock: Total (h)", "CPU: Total (h)"], stub="Method", exclude=())],
           rank_note="in each column, the best being the shortest time")
latex.report("evRuntimeFfMedian", float(s_.median()), digits=2, desc="Flow field: median seconds per origin")
BL_HOURS = pd.Series([r["provenance"]["hours"] for r in BL_RUNS.values()])
latex.report("evRuntimeBlMedianHours", float(BL_HOURS.median()), digits=1,
             desc="bayesLife: median hours per run (both machines)")
latex.report("evRuntimeBlMaxHours", float(BL_HOURS.max()), digits=1, desc="bayesLife: longest run (hours)")
latex.report("evRuntimeSpaceMedian", float(SPACE_T["seconds"].median()), digits=2,
             desc="Median seconds to estimate the space the two forecasters share, per origin")
latex.report("evRuntimeFfSpaceMedian", float(FF_SPACE.median()), digits=2,
             desc="Flow field with the estimation of its space: median seconds per origin")
# How much faster the flow field, with its space, is than each other method: the ratio of that method's
# median per origin (the faster of its two fitting periods; bayesLife's median over all its runs) to the flow
# field's, and its order of magnitude.  The ensemble needs anchored MDMx, Lee–Carter and the flow field.
ORDER_WORD = {1: "one", 2: "two", 3: "three", 4: "four", 5: "five", 6: "six"}
_med = {"Mdmx": min(pd.Series({o: r["seconds"] for o, r in runs["mdmx"][pol].items()}).median()
                    for pol in ("full", "win")),
        "Cmp": min(pd.Series({o: r["seconds"] for o, r in runs["comparators"][pol].items()}).median()
                   for pol in ("full", "win")),
        "Bl": float(BL_HOURS.median()) * 3600}
_what = {"Mdmx": "anchored MDMx (the faster fitting period)",
         "Cmp": "Lee–Carter, Hyndman–Ullah and the coherent FDM together (one R session; the faster period)",
         "Bl": "bayesLife (median run, both machines)"}
for k_, v_ in _med.items():
    ratio = v_ / float(FF_SPACE.median())
    two_sig = float(f"{ratio:.2g}")
    latex.report(f"evRuntimeRatio{k_}", two_sig, text=latex.fmt_int(int(round(two_sig))),
                 desc=f"How many times faster the flow field (with its space) is than {_what[k_]}, two significant digits")
    orders = int(np.floor(np.log10(ratio)))
    latex.report(f"evRuntimeOrders{k_}", orders, text=ORDER_WORD[orders],
                 desc=f"Orders of magnitude by which the flow field (with its space) is faster than {_what[k_]}")
_bl_mdmx = float(BL_HOURS.median()) * 3600 / _med["Mdmx"]
latex.report("evRuntimeRatioBlMdmx", float(f"{_bl_mdmx:.2g}"), text=latex.fmt_int(int(round(float(f"{_bl_mdmx:.2g}")))),
             desc="How many times longer bayesLife's median run takes than anchored MDMx's (faster period), two significant digits")
rt_tab.round(2)
```

The flow field takes `{python} num("evRuntimeFfMedian")` seconds per origin (all
its populations, forecasts and schedules), and `{python} num("evRuntimeFfSpaceMedian")`
with the space it shares with anchored MDMx (`{python} num("evRuntimeSpaceMedian")` s).
That is about `{python} num("evRuntimeRatioMdmx")` times faster than anchored MDMx,
`{python} num("evRuntimeRatioCmp")` times faster than the three R comparators together
and `{python} num("evRuntimeRatioBl")` times faster than bayesLife, which takes
`{python} num("evRuntimeBlMedianHours")` hours per run (median; the longest
`{python} num("evRuntimeBlMaxHours")`; `{python} num("evBlHours")` run-hours for its
`{python} num("evBlRuns")` runs).

The other methods' times are those of the render that computed them, on this
book's machine (`{python} ev.machine()`).  bayesLife's `{python} num("evBlRuns")` runs
were made by the off-site batch on two machines: `{python} BL_WHERE`.  Each
bayesLife run's three chains run in parallel; MDMx's fits run in parallel worker
processes; the R comparators run as one R session per origin for all three
methods.  Runs shared cores, so the times are indicative; the differences
between the methods are of orders of magnitude.

## The held-out block

The origins 2005–2015 (paper §10.1 and §10.6) were held out from every formal choice of form and
design (what had been seen there is listed with the design above).  They were
scored once, under the frozen design, by the run that set
`score_held_out = true` and changed nothing else, as the design
required.  The overall comparison was revised afterwards (Deviation 2) and
corrected (Deviation 3), so the revised comparison's held-out view, reported
first below, is not a blind test of the revised design; the frozen design's
view is reported beside it.  The block reaches at most
`{python} int(years[-1]) - min(D.held_out)` years ahead, so this section reports
the primary view's comparison and the bands up to that horizon.

```{python}
#| label: ev-held-out
#| code-summary: "The held-out block: scored only when score_held_out is true"
if HELD:
    HEADLINE_HELD = ev.headline(OVERALL[("held_out", "full")], "held", post_hoc=True, **view_span("held_out"),
                                **HL)
    HEADLINE_HELD_FROZEN = ev.headline(OVERALL_FROZEN[("held_out", "full")], "held", **view_span("held_out"), **HL)
    held_bands = bands[bands["era"] == "held"].pivot_table(index="entry", columns="band", values="mae", observed=True)
    held_bands.columns = [shown("held", b) for b in held_bands.columns]
    print("Held-out view (origins 2005–2015, horizons 1–15):", HEADLINE_HELD)
    display_ = held_bands.reindex(ENTRIES + [ev.NAIVE]).round(2)
else:
    HEADLINE_HELD = "not yet scored"
    display_ = "The held-out block has not been scored yet (score_held_out = false)."
display_
```

```{python}
#| label: ev-held-out-text
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
FUNC_TAGS = ("LcAll", "LcWin", "HuAll", "HuWin", "CfdmAll", "CfdmWin")
pi_fail = pd.concat([r["failures"].assign(policy="last 50 years" if p_ == "win" else "every year")
                     for (p_, o), r in runs["intervals"].items()], ignore_index=True)
held_fail = pi_fail[pi_fail["origin"].isin(D.held_out)]
if HELD:
    print(f"{HEADLINE_HELD}  Under the frozen design, by which the block was scored that once: "
          f"{HEADLINE_HELD_FROZEN[0].lower() + HEADLINE_HELD_FROZEN[1:]}  "
          f"bayesLife fitted to the last {D.window} years ranks "
          f"{ev.ordinal(num('evPlaceHeldOutFullBlWin'))} and the ensemble {ev.ordinal(num('evPlaceHeldOutFullEns'))}.  "
          f"At 1–5 years ahead the flow field's error of e₀ is {num('evMaeFfHeldOneFive')} years, anchored MDMx's "
          f"{num('evMaeMdmxWinHeldOneFive')} (last 50 years), bayesLife's {num('evMaeBlWinHeldOneFive')}, the naive's "
          f"{num('evMaeNaiveHeldOneFive')}, and Lee–Carter's {num('evMaeLcWinHeldOneFive')}: the functional comparators "
          + ("all lose to" if min(val(f"evMae{t}HeldOneFive") for t in FUNC_TAGS) > val("evMaeNaiveHeldOneFive")
             else "do not all lose to")
          + " the naive there.  The entries' own intervals cover "
          + ("more than" if min(val("evCovFfHeldEighty"), val("evCovMdmxAllHeldEighty")) > 80 else "about")
          + f" their nominal level on these outcomes: the flow field's 80 % intervals, calibrated on the late era's "
          f"errors ({num('evCalHeldOverlapShare')} % of which fall after the earliest held-out origin), cover "
          f"{num('evCovFfHeldEighty')} %, and "
          f"anchored MDMx's {num('evCovMdmxAllHeldEighty')} % (all years).  The frozen design, which scores each "

          "interval simulation failed"
          + (" (" + "; ".join(f"{r.method} for {r.pop} from {r.origin}, {r.policy}: {r.message}"

```

The flow field's two other forms, FR0-all (the speed beyond the frontier point held at its
value there) and FR2-all (the form the frontier rule as written chose), are variants, never
ranked.  They were not run on the held-out block when it was scored; they are run here, after
it, and described beside the ranked flow field (FR1-50) on the same points.  No choice depends
on them.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-held-forms
#| tbl-cap: "The flow field's three forms on the held-out block (described, never ranked): MAE and mean error of e₀ (average of the sexes) by horizon band."
if HELD:
    HF_FORMS = {k: v for k, v in va.flow_variant_forms(ctx["flowfield"]).items() if k in ("FR0-all", "FR2-all")}
    held_jobs = ctx["jobs"]["full"][ctx["jobs"]["full"]["origin"].isin(D.held_out)].reset_index(drop=True)
    HF_RUNS = va.run_flow_variants(ctx["M"], ctx["observed"], ctx["pops"], ctx["years"], held_jobs, ctx["mdmx"],
                                   HF_FORMS, ctx["e0"], horizon=D.horizon, design=D, name="evaluation_ffvar_held",
                                   allow_held=True)
    HF_RES = va.variant_results({"flow": HF_RUNS}, n_ages=A, ax=ctx["cmp"]["mx_to_qx_ax"])
    hf_err = ev.errors(ev.long_points({lab: HF_RES[lab] for lab in HF_FORMS}), truth, keys)
    hf_err = pd.concat([both_err[both_err["entry"] == ev.FLOW_FIELD], hf_err[hf_err["measure"] == "e0_both"]],
                       ignore_index=True)
    hf_err = hf_err[hf_err["origin"].isin(D.held_out)]
    hf_bands = ev.band_table(hf_err, D, ["entry"])
    if hf_bands.groupby("band", observed=True)["n"].nunique().max() != 1:
        raise ValueError("FR0-all and FR2-all are not scored on the flow field's held-out points")
    HF_LABELS = [ev.FLOW_FIELD, *HF_FORMS]
    HF_TAG = {ev.FLOW_FIELD: "Ff", "FR0-all": "FrZeroAll", "FR2-all": "FrTwoAll"}
    for r_ in hf_bands[hf_bands["entry"] != ev.FLOW_FIELD].itertuples():
        b_ = shown("held", r_.band)
        for stat, word in (("mae", "Mae"), ("me", "Bias")):
            latex.report(f"evVar{word}{HF_TAG[r_.entry]}Held{BAND_TAG[b_]}", getattr(r_, stat), digits=2,
                         desc=f"{r_.entry} (variant, described): {stat} of e0 (average), held-out block, horizons {b_}")
    HF_OUT = pd.concat(
        [hf_bands.pivot_table(index="entry", columns="band", values=stat, observed=True).reindex(HF_LABELS)
         .rename(columns=lambda b: shown("held", b)).rename_axis("Entry").reset_index().assign(Group=name)
         for stat, name in (("mae", "MAE of $e_0$"), ("me", "Mean error of $e_0$"))], ignore_index=True)
    HF_OUT["Entry"] = HF_OUT["Entry"].replace({ev.FLOW_FIELD: "Flow field (FR1-50, ranked)"})
    HF_OUT = years_ahead(HF_OUT[["Group", "Entry", *[c for c in HF_OUT.columns if c not in ("Group", "Entry")]]])
    save_table(HF_OUT, "tbl-ev-held-forms",
               "The flow field's three forms at the recent origins "
               f"({min(D.held_out)}--{max(D.held_out)}): the ranked form, FR1-50, and FR0-all and FR2-all, which "
               "are not part of the overall comparison.  MAE and mean error of $e_0$ "
               "(the average of the sexes, years) by horizon band, on the same points; the last band ends at the "
               "data's last year.",
               short_caption="The flow field's forms at the recent origins", formats=formats(HF_OUT, 2),
               groups="Group", spanners=": ", rank=ranked_bands(HF_OUT),
               rank_note=RANK_BANDS.replace("in each column", "among the three forms in each column"))
    HF_W = hf_bands.pivot_table(index="entry", columns="band", values="mae", observed=True)
    HF_BEST = {shown("held", b): HF_W[b].idxmin() for b in HF_W.columns}
    display_hf = HF_OUT.round(2)
else:
    HF_BEST = {}
    display_hf = "The held-out block has not been scored yet (score_held_out = false)."
display_hf
```

By horizon band, the form with the lowest MAE on the held-out block:
`{python} "; ".join(f"{b}: {lab if lab != ev.FLOW_FIELD else 'FR1-50'}" for b, lab in HF_BEST.items()) or "not scored"`.

## The headline on the release on which the design was chosen

The forms and the evaluation's design were chosen on an earlier HMD release.  The article gives the
headline on the later release only.  The numbers on the earlier release are those of this chapter rendered
on it; `config/release-20260218.json` keeps the shares of first places, the mean ranks and
positions, and the leave-one-origin-out shares (`tools/freeze_previous_release.py` writes it, with
the SHA-256 of its source).  Each is reported here as a macro `evFeb…` beside the one above.

```{python}
#| label: ev-previous-release
#| code-summary: "The headline numbers on the earlier release, from the file that keeps them"
prev = json.loads((paths.root() / "config" / "release-20260218.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
prev_date = pd.Timestamp(prev["release"]["id"])
latex.report("evFebReleaseDate", f"{prev_date.day} {prev_date:%B %Y}", desc="Date of the earlier HMD release")
for key_, rec in prev["numbers"].items():
    latex.report("evFeb" + key_[2:], rec["value"], text=rec["text"],
                 desc=f"On the HMD release of {prev_date.day} {prev_date:%B %Y}: {rec['desc']}")
print(f"{len(prev['numbers'])} numbers on the release of {prev_date:%d %B %Y}, from {prev['source']['ref']}")
```
